Manually adding watermarks to multiple videos is time-consuming, and keeping the same style or logo on all of them is almost impossible. We help you batch watermark videos in one go with fast and professional results.
A professional watermark tool designed for videographers, businesses, artists, influencers, and creators. eZy Watermark Videos editor adjusts video resolution, overlays videos with brand logo watermarks, and protects videos from unauthorized use.

Perfect for video protection with custom watermarking for your business.

ADD WATERMARK TO VIDEOS:

Protect videos online by adding a customized watermark to videos. Personalize to add text on videos, put QR codes, digitally sign your videos, add logos, add watermark video, date stamp on video, add label on videos, timestamps, and copyright stamp on a video.

SINGLE AND BATCH PROCESSING:

Watermark video editor processes single videos as well as hundreds of videos in batch video editor, all within seconds. You can easily add text to videos in bulk and in single mode. Save time with batch watermarking — batch watermark videos in seconds, perfect for creators on the go.

CUSTOMIZED WATERMARKS:

You can easily adjust opacity, rotation, size, position, and placements of your watermarks. Customize text watermarks with your own fonts, colors, and styles to give them a personal touch and make your videos truly yours.

AI POWERED TEMPLATES:

Powered by AI, eZy Watermark introduces adaptive templates that intelligently adjust watermarks across videos, delivering a consistent and refined batch watermarking experience.

CLOUD-SYNCED TEMPLATES:

All templates are securely synced to the cloud, ensuring they are always up to date and available wherever you need them.

CREATE AND SAVE WATERMARK TEMPLATES:

You can create your own watermark templates and save them for later, so you don’t have to start from scratch every time. Just create a template once; your logo, text, style, everything and reuse it whenever you need to add custom watermarks to your videos.

TILE WATERMARKS:

Apply your watermark in a repeated pattern across the entire video for stronger protection and professional-looking results.

SNAP TO GRID:

Easily place your watermark exactly where you want it. Our grid snapping feature helps you align it perfectly, giving your videos a consistent and professional look.

IMPORT & EXPORT WATERMARK VIDEOS:

We make it easy to import videos from your camera, library, or capture a new video directly from camera. Save your edited videos with stylish watermarks to your gallery or share them instantly on Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, or Google Drive! Whether you are sharing product videos or travel shots, your content stays yours.

MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT:

eZy Watermark Videos is available in many languages, including Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, so everyone can use it easily.
